en.content:

1A + 2B 3C + 4D

Concentration of C changes from 10 mmol dm3 to 20 mmol dm3 in 10 seconds. Rate of appearance of D is 1.5 times the rate of disappearance of B which is twice the rate of disappearance A. The rate of appearance of D has been experimentally determined to be 9 mmol dm3 s1. Therefore, the rate of reaction is _____________ mmol dm3 s1. (Nearest Integer)
en.explanation: Rate
